title: Extracting Small Translation Specialists from LLMs by Aggressively Pruning Experts
abstract: arXiv:2605.28042v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) achieve state-of-the-art machine translation performance, but they do so as broad generalists largely trained for many tasks and capabilities unrelated to translation. Thus, they are heavily overparameterized for this task, resulting in excessive memory and compute requirements. In this paper, we present a method for aggressively pruning experts from modern mixture-of-experts LLMs while incurring negligible degradation in translation quality. Our approach exploits expert specialization and the separability of multilingual capabilities in LLMs to identify experts irrelevant to translation. And because of the modular nature of MoEs, these can be easily pruned without any training. Without retraining, we are able to prune half of all experts with negligible degradation and 70% with only minor losses. translated_title: 通过激进剪枝专家从大语言模型中提取小型翻译专家
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）在机器翻译任务上达到了最先进的性能，但它们作为广泛的通才模型，其训练主要面向许多与翻译无关的任务和能力。因此，对于翻译任务而言，它们存在严重的过度参数化问题，导致了过多的内存和计算需求。在本文中，我们提出了一种从现代混合专家（MoE）大语言模型中激进剪枝专家的方法，同时几乎不会造成翻译质量的下降。我们的方法利用专家专业化特性以及大语言模型中多语言能力的可分离性，来识别与翻译无关的专家。得益于MoE的模块化特性，这些专家可以轻松地被剪枝，无需任何训练。在不进行重新训练的情况下，我们能够剪掉一半的专家而几乎不造成性能下降，剪掉70%的专家仅带来轻微损失。通过非常短的监督微调（SFT），我们可以剪掉75%的专家，同时恢复基线性能，在某些情况下……
tldr: 提出一种利用专家专业化和多语言能力可分离性的方法，无需训练即可从混合专家大语言模型中剪枝多达70%（结合短暂微调可达75%）的与翻译无关的专家，在几乎不损失翻译质量的前提下大幅压缩模型规模。
en_tdlr: A training-free method that aggressively prunes up to 70% (75% with brief SFT) of translation-irrelevant experts from mixture-of-experts LLMs by exploiting expert specialization and the separability of multilingual capabilities, drastically reducing model size with negligible translation quality loss.
